c3_diagnosis.next_native_correction: Put TexCreate_ShaderResource with TexCreate_UAV in Create2DDesc TargetableFlags; test that descriptor contract before a new native build and dispatch.

fo4.original: A correct 1280x720 staging layout can still contain unsupported pixels. The first C1 PIE session mapped pitch 1280 and height 720 but returned format 18, PF_A2B10G10R10. Stock 4.25 defaults r.DefaultBackBufferPixelFormat to 4. Its value 0 selects PF_B8G8R8A8; apply the process-only renderer-settings INI override before viewport creation with -nowrite. Do not reinterpret 10-bit bytes as 8-bit pixels or weaken the image reader. Source anchors and preserved evidence are in [the retry note](europa/09431b-c1-format-retry.md).
